definitions.supplemental: In Bd. 4, 23; S. 595, 40 for upcundne swég read uppe cúðne swég; v. Bd. M. 340, 5.

quotations.old_english: Cuman tó ðam upcundan æþelan ríce
Ðæt wé magon upcund ríce gestígan

source_text: up-cund; adj. Supernal, celestial :-- Onǽled mid ðý upcundan leóhte illustrates superno lumine, Past. 49; Swt. 379, 24. Cuman tó ðam upcundan æþelan ríce, Exon. Th. 17, 10; Cri. 268. Ðæt wé magon upcund ríce gestígan, 348, 27; Sch. 34. Upcundra ceastergewarena supernorum civium, Hpt. Gl. 423, 5. Upcundra eádegum setlum sedibus superum beatis, Dóm. L. 303. [In Bd. 4, 23; S. 595, 40 for upcundne swég read uppe cúðne swég; v. Bd. M. 340, 5.]
